claims: The Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026, from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Artemis II mission's crewed Orion spacecraft is conducting a ~10-day mission.
The Artemis II mission's crewed Orion spacecraft orbits the Moon before returning to Earth.
The Artemis II mission's launch site is Kennedy Space Center, FL (Pad 39B).
The Artemis II mission is in orbit.
The Artemis II mission is beginning its transit toward the Moon.
The Artemis II mission's goal is a 10-day flight path to test systems for future moon landings.
Real-time data for the Artemis II mission is monitored at NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston.
Reid Wiseman is the Commander of the Artemis II mission's crew.
Victor Glover is the Pilot of the Artemis II mission's crew.
Christina Koch is a Mission Specialist of the Artemis II mission's crew.
Jeremy Hansen is a Mission Specialist of the Artemis II mission's crew.
The Artemis II mission's crew will circle the Moon before splashing down in the Pacific Ocean.
